variants.name: 프리미어 통합형
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE distinct, high-fidelity desktop UI concept image for an Adobe Premiere Pro extension that automatically synchronizes podcast cameras and cuts to the active speaker. This is an illustrative design proposal, not a real screenshot. Landscape 16:9, high resolution, razor-sharp flat front-facing UI, no perspective, no laptop or phone mockup, no exterior scenery, no watermark.
Professional editing software, clear functional hierarchy, plausible buildable desktop controls. A subtly subdued Premiere-like dark editing workspace may provide context: source bins, a podcast video monitor, and timeline. Do not recreate unnecessary small menu text. Main custom extension must be visually dominant and legible. Two fictional Korean adult podcast hosts at a studio table with microphones appear ONLY in small video previews: one male host, one female guest, and optional two-person wide shot.
Core workflow: select existing project clips or current sequence; auto synchronize; choose separate microphone tracks or mixed recording; map detected speakers to cameras; review; create an editable new sequence preserving originals. These are editing tools, not analytics dashboards. Avoid fake accuracy percentages, financial metrics, cloud upload prompts, stock market graphs, lorem ipsum, and implementation terms such as Python, UXP, API, JSON.
Use a modern, highly legible Korean sans-serif like Pretendard/Noto Sans KR. Render Korean labels exactly where used. Product header: "화자 자동 편집". Recording choices: "개별 마이크", "혼합 녹음". Input choices: "프로젝트 클립", "현재 시퀀스". Workflow labels: "파일", "싱크", "화자", "편집". Camera labels: "CAM 1", "CAM 2", "WIDE". Speaker labels: "진행자", "게스트". Helpful controls: "자동 싱크", "최소 컷 길이", "짧은 발화 유지", "검토하기". Primary CTA exactly: "편집 시퀀스 만들기". Quiet preservation note exactly: "원본 유지". Example settings: "2.0초", duration "48:32". Do not cram every label if it harms legibility, but show both recording choices, synchronization, speaker-camera mapping, and the primary CTA. Icons should be small, consistent, crisp line icons. All text aligned on a disciplined grid.
CONCEPT 01: NATIVE DOCKED PANEL. Make this the practical recommended professional option. Background is a calm, matte charcoal Premiere workspace. On the RIGHT, a wide enough docked vertical custom extension panel occupies about 43% of the frame and nearly full height; left side shows a restrained program monitor above an editing timeline. The extension looks genuinely integrated, not like a website pasted into the app. Near-black #202124, layered graphite #2B2D31, crisp thin dividers, restrained violet #A78BFA for selected controls and primary CTA, small mint completion checks. Small corner caption "01 / NATIVE PANEL". Header and a compact four-step progress row at top. Below: segmented input picker, completed auto-sync row "싱크 완료", recording mode switch, then TWO clean horizontal speaker mapping rows with thumbnail, speaker name, camera selector, and audio-play icon. A small WIDE assignment row, two compact editing settings, and one review-warning row "확인 필요 1". Sticky bottom full-width violet primary CTA and quiet "원본 유지". Dense but breathable. Minimal rounded corners, 6px-like radius, no oversized promotional headings. Emphasize immediate real-world usability and native compatibility.
